summary: infoblox.nios_modules nios_next_network lookup now requires an integer cidr argument instead of defaulting to 24.
questions: Why does nios_next_network fail with missing required argument: cidr?

answer_card.title: nios_next_network requires cidr
answer_card.answer_md: The `nios_next_network` lookup now **requires** `cidr` as an integer. It used to default silently to `24`; playbooks relying on that now fail with `AnsibleError: missing required argument: cidr`. Pass `cidr` explicitly.
